title: Is support included
response: Yes. Support covers download and access issues, extracting files, preparing the USB drive and questions about how to run the toolkit. Write to {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}} and include the e-mail you used at checkout so we can look you up quickly.
followup: Would you like to send a question to support now?

title: How to contact us
patterns: can i talk to a human
response: E-mail is the fastest route: **{{SUPPORT_EMAIL}}**. Support is human, not a ticket robot, and replies usually come back within one business day. For pre-sale questions, I can answer most of them here too.
followup: Anything I can clear up right now?

title: Who makes it
response: The toolkit is produced and supported by KitTecnico Pro, a team that works in PC repair and IT maintenance. The package has been sold and used by technicians in Brazil and Portugal for years; we are now bringing it to the US market.
followup: Would you like to see the interface before buying?

title: Receipt and invoice
patterns: i need a receipt for my business
response: Your checkout confirmation e-mail works as your receipt. If you need an invoice with your business details, email {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}} with the information to include and we will send one over.

title: Privacy and data
patterns: how do you handle my data
what do you do with my email
response: Your e-mail is used to deliver your purchase and to provide support afterwards. Payment details are handled entirely by the checkout provider and never reach us. We do not sell or share buyer data with third parties for marketing.

title: Pre-sale questions
patterns: i have a question before buying
i need to check something first
response: Ask away — that is what I am here for. The most common pre-sale checks are Windows version, machine brands, the USB drive size and whether the interface language works for you.
followup: Which of those would you like to go through?
